sources.title: classifiers: implement the byte-feature integer MLP runtime #12
sources.snippet: The native runtime binds exact program/profile/weight identities, validates the fixed affine/ReLU/affine export, rejects int32 partial-sum overflow before rescaling, processes all prompt bytes and applies max aggregation with a strict threshold.

sources.title: GitHub - AbdelStark/hallmark: Research on transcript-bound classifier ...
sources.snippet: Research on transcript-bound classifier verdicts. The intended system pairs hardware-attested model provenance with independently verifiable classifier computation. A classifier pass is a result under a fixed policy, not evidence of safety in the world. - AbdelStark/hallmark
